# MeetChrisC.com

> Personal home of Chris C. in Austin, Texas. Retired, curious, into live music, good sushi, walks with Lola, and learning to build on the web with AI.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.meetchrisc.com/): Personal home of Chris C. in Austin, Texas. Retired, curious, into live music, good sushi, walks with Lola, and learning to build on the web with AI.
- [Videos](https://www.meetchrisc.com/videos): Videos by Chris C. in Austin, Texas — things I've made on video, starting with the Wizard of Oz experience at Sphere in Las Vegas.
- [Art](https://www.meetchrisc.com/art): Art by Chris C. in Austin, Texas — pop-art pieces I've made over the years, starting with watch movements.

## Writing

- [11 P.M. at Crunch Southpark Meadows](https://www.meetchrisc.com/posts/11-pm-crunch-southpark-meadows): I work out at 11 p.m. seven nights a week. Moving to Austin, every house got measured against one question: how far is the nearest gym that's open at midnight?
- [Say Nothing, and Mean It](https://www.meetchrisc.com/posts/say-nothing-and-mean-it): You read the long angry message at 11:52 at night, wrote three replies in your head, and sent none of them. On silence, and when it's a fence, not a fist.
- [The Quiet Kind of Strong](https://www.meetchrisc.com/posts/the-quiet-kind-of-strong): The strongest people I know show up, hold it together in public, then sit in the truck for twenty minutes before going inside. On grief, healing, and peace.
- [Why I gave up all my furniture — and why I'll never go back](https://www.meetchrisc.com/posts/why-i-gave-up-all-my-furniture): The movers wanted $14,000–$20,000 to move my furniture from LA to Austin. I gave away 95% of it. What I kept, what I miss, and why the house feels perfect.
- [Why I started this site](https://www.meetchrisc.com/posts/why-i-started-this-site): I retired in January and started learning to build on the web with AI. This site is where I practice.
